purpose: Glass-box registry of what each Cursor agent rule, skill, and governed capability does. Nothing agent-facing is active unless listed here.

agents.does: Implements product code, versioned /api/v1 APIs, layered tests, CI, docs, and engine work under registered rules and skills.

registry.does: Requires unit, functional, integration, regression, black-box, and E2E tests on every implementation (backend/tests/{unit,integration,functional,regression,blackbox,e2e}), plus self-verification before done.
Requires a dedicated versioned git branch for the next version of an implementation (feat/<area>-vN); current work uses feat/ci-workflow-v1.
Requires all public HTTP APIs under /api/v{N}/...; Hayah-Pulse public contract is /api/v1/health, /api/v1/residents, /api/v1/engine, /api/v1/metrics.
Requires every new or changed agent rule, skill, hook, or governed capability to be registered in .cursor/governance.json.
Lazy-senior mode: smallest complete change; levels lite/full/ultra; pairs with review/audit/debt/gain/help skills.
UI/UX design intelligence: design systems, styles, typography, accessibility, and stack-specific UI guidance.
GitHub Actions one-box/one-column UI: ci.yml calls reusable test-pipeline.yml nesting lint→unit→integration→functional→regression→blackbox→e2e→all.
Runs config YAML structure, secret-pattern scan, doc-config-drift, and relative markdown link checks used by CI static jobs.
Hosts the six required pytest layers (unit, integration, functional, regression, blackbox, e2e) enforced by rule.testing-required and CI job chain.
Serves the versioned public HTTP contract under /api/v1 for health, residents, engine outputs, and metrics.
